notablePrerequisites: You've lost 2 or more life this turn.
easyPrerequisites:
Rowan does not have summoning sickness.
Woodwork Prodigy is prepared.
description:
Activate Rowan by tapping it, reducing the cost of your instant or sorcery spells until end of turn.
Cast the prepared copy of Soul Tether by paying {R/G} through the reduction from Rowan.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Biblioplex Tomekeeper.
When Biblioplex Tomekeeper enters, it triggers, re-preparing Woodwork Prodigy.
Resolve the copy of Soul Tether, creating a Heartwood token.
Activate the Heartwood token by tapping it, adding {R} or {G}.
Repeat.
